description: 14 CFR 91.155(b)(2), Class G's one exception to 91.155(a) for an airplane (eCFR, current on 2026-11-21): below 1,200 ft above the surface (not at it: the table's low row is "1,200 feet or less"), at night, in an airport traffic pattern within 1/2 mile of the runway, with the visibility under 3 statute miles but not under 1, the airplane may fly clear of clouds. By day the table's low row already asks 1 sm and clear of clouds (91.155(a)); 91.155(b)(1) is the helicopter's. A visibility not given leaves the other conditions to decide.

in_pattern.description: In an airport traffic pattern within 1/2 mile of the runway.

visibility_sm.description: Statute miles; null where not known.
The least visibility it asks, 1 sm.

under_visibility_sm.description: It is for a visibility under this, 3 sm.
